scripts.text:
[Sheriff Assistant]
Welcome to Rock Ridge, the hot, dry desert in the West where adventure is waiting!
I'm the sheriff's assistant, and I'm here to guide visitors. Is there a place you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[治安官助手]
歡迎來到西部的洛克理奇！
這裡沙漠炎熱乾燥，也有冒險等著您！
我是治安官的助手，負責為訪客引路。
您想去哪兒？

scripts.text:
[Sheriff Assistant]
Tell me where you want to go, and I'll show you where it is.
Also, you can use ^B9062FNavigation^000000 mode by ^B9062Fclicking the name of the place^000000 I showed to you.
scripts.translation:
[治安官助手]
告訴我您想去哪兒，我就給您指路。
您還可以使用^B9062F導航^000000模式，只需^B9062F點選我提供的地名^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sheriff Assistant]
The ^006400Kafra Employee^000000, got it. Please click the ^0000FFBox icon^000000 on your mini-map.
Is there anywhere else you want to check?
scripts.translation:
[治安官助手]
找^006400卡普拉職員^000000，對吧？
請點選小地圖上的^0000FF箱子圖示^000000。
還有其他想檢視的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sheriff Assistant]
I've marked the location of the <NAVI>Inn<INFO>harboro1,156,215,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> on your mini-map.
Click the name to activate Navigation mode.
Is there anywhere else you want to check?
scripts.translation:
[治安官助手]
我已在您的小地圖上標記了<NAVI>旅館<INFO>harboro1,156,215,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>的位置。
點選名稱即可啟動導航模式。
還有其他想檢視的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sheriff Assistant]
I've marked the location of the <NAVI>Weapon/Armor Shop<INFO>harboro1,312,193,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> on your mini-map.

scripts.translation:

還有其他想檢視的地方嗎？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

還有其他想檢視的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sheriff Assistant]
Let me remove all the marks on your mini-map.
Is there anywhere else you want to check?
scripts.translation:
[治安官助手]
我來清除您小地圖上的所有標記。
還有其他想檢視的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sheriff Assistant]
Enjoy your stay in Rock Ridge!
scripts.translation:
[治安官助手]
祝您在洛克理奇過得愉快！
